name: India
headline: India: +7.8% growth in 2025, 2.0% inflation, debt 84% of GDP
sections: India is a $3.91 trillion economy (2025), the world's 7th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +7.8% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $12K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 13.5% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 2.0% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.6% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 5.0% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 16.0% (2025).
Gross government debt is 84% of GDP (2025), a elevated level that has fallen from 90% in 2020. The general government balance is −7.4% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is −0.7% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 46% of GDP (2025), a relatively closed economy. Net FDI inflows were 1.0% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 75% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 72.2 years (2024). Population: 1463.9 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
